title: R' Avin Zutrati
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin records that he reports in the name of R' Yehudah bar Zevina, citing [Berakhot 12b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.12b.14). Our reading is Rabbi Abbahu bar Zutrati; Dikdukei Soferim reads, “Rabbi bar Zutrati said.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman reports the words of the apparatus as “Rabbi bar Zutrati said.” The name of the speaker is left as printed in that reported form.

The linked Berakhot gives Rabbi Abbahu ben Zutrati speaking in the name of Rabbi Yehudah bar Zevida. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1105&lang=en) also lists Rabbi Abbahu under Zutrati. Hyman retains Avin and Zevina in his account of Yuchasin.
